from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Big Question: Why Sum Variables?", [
            "We often combine independent random processes.",
            "Let Z be the sum of X and Y.",
            "Total delivery time equals travel plus unloading time."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display formula Z = X + Y in #FFFFFF at center of grid.
        formula = MathTex("Z = X + Y", color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(formula, "B2", "B5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            Write(formula)
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Character 'Delivery Robot' appears in #ADD8E6 
        # with 'Travel Time' (X) and 'Unloading Time' (Y) labels.
        
        # Robot representation (Vectorized group)
        robot_color = "#ADD8E6"
        body = Square(side_length=0.6, color=robot_color, fill_opacity=1)
        head = Square(side_length=0.3, color=robot_color, fill_opacity=1).shift(UP*0.45)
        eye_l = Dot(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.07 + UP*0.05, radius=0.03, color=BLACK)
        eye_r = Dot(head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.07 + UP*0.05, radius=0.03, color=BLACK)
        robot = VGroup(body, head, eye_l, eye_r)
        self.place_at_grid(robot, "D2", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Component X (Travel Time)
        bar_x = Rectangle(width=1.0, height=0.3, color="#FFFF00", fill_opacity=0.8)
        label_x = MathTex("X", color="#FFFF00").scale(0.8).next_to(bar_x, UP, buff=0.1)
        x_comp = VGroup(bar_x, label_x)
        self.place_at_grid(x_comp, "D3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Component Y (Unloading Time)
        bar_y = Rectangle(width=0.6, height=0.3, color="#00FF00", fill_opacity=0.8)
        label_y = MathTex("Y", color="#00FF00").scale(0.8).next_to(bar_y, UP, buff=0.1)
        y_comp = VGroup(bar_y, label_y)
        self.place_at_grid(y_comp, "D4", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            FadeIn(robot),
            FadeIn(x_comp),
            FadeIn(y_comp)
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight Z as the total span with a bracket in #FF69B4.
        
        # Combined bars to show total span
        bar_x_copy = bar_x.copy()
        bar_y_copy = bar_y.copy()
        combined_bars = VGroup(bar_x_copy, bar_y_copy).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0)
        self.place_in_area(combined_bars, "F3", "F4", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        bracket = Brace(combined_bars, direction=DOWN, color="#FF69B4")
        z_label = MathTex("Z = X + Y", color="#FF69B4").scale(0.8).next_to(bracket, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW),
            TransformFromCopy(VGroup(bar_x, bar_y), combined_bars),
            Create(bracket),
            FadeIn(z_label)
        )
        self.wait(3)
